title: Agent Org
description: Live organizational state of a self-organizing agent org: the whole node tree with charters inlined. This schema validates STRUCTURE only. Semantic coverage rules (coverage, no-overlap, no-disjoint-excludes, parent/child back-references, acyclicity, seam ownership) are enforced by the splitter on every split; see .github/org-design.md §2.2.

version.description: Org-state version. Bumped by exactly one on every committed split.

root.description: id of the root node. The Host hardcodes the entry point to this node.

id.description: Stable, hierarchy-free identifier. Never renamed across reorgs.

parent.description: id of the parent node, or null for the root.

children.description: ids of direct children. Empty for a Leaf.

mode.description: Parent = scatter-gather over children. Leaf = executes directly.

excludes.description: Globs inside domain that are owned elsewhere (a child, or a sibling via the common parent). Every exclude MUST be covered by another node's domain (enforced by the splitter on split; see org-design.md §2.2).
